name: THOR
summary: Tactical Hazardous Operations Robot — a lightweight electric humanoid built by Virginia Tech's RoMeLa (with UPenn and others) for the DARPA Robotics Challenge, using series-elastic actuators. The THOR-RD variant competed in the 2015 DRC finals and won the RoboCup 2015 adult-size robot-soccer title, seeding RoMeLa's later work toward ARTEMIS.
notable: US university DRC entry with compliant electric actuation
